context:
Goal: q_max's browser tier goes green so #1011 and the q_max batch can merge.
Problem (rule): q_max decision D-799 (A browser check deletes the rows it seeds) puts clean-up in each check's own finally. About 40 checks skip it, so 87 jobs pile up by 14-FLOSS, the seeded jobs fall off the 50-row Jobs page, and about a dozen checks time out. Changing D-799 needs your word or the arbiter's (D-749, An entry changes only on a new ruling).
Based on (measured): the lane's local full run counted jobs per check; CONTENT-UNIT went red at 444 s without clean-up, green at 80 s with it (PR #1029's first fix f1706d3b; the draft's head is now 9b74285d).
Based on (read): main's browser run 41861801325 ended RED on Nov 4, so #1011 waits on this fix.
Departs from: q_max main (D-799: each check cleans up in its own finally) — a moves job clean-up to the shared runner runCheck; b adds a finally to each of about 40 checks.
home: q_max D-799, A browser check deletes the rows it seeds

options.gain: One place does it, and a new check cannot leak.
options.how: runCheck removes each check's finished jobs; a check keeps its own finally for other rows.
options.label: Rewrite D-799: the runner removes each check's finished jobs
options.lose: A job a later check needs must be registered to keep it for the run.

options.how: Add a finally to each of about 40 checks.
options.label: Keep D-799 and fix each check
options.lose: About 40 edits, and the next new check can leak again.
